claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if the garnet product line is discontinued or if circulator architectures move away from garnet-based Faraday rotation; upgrade when any circulator maker or hyperscaler names its garnet source, or industry disclosure quantifies the O-band garnet supply base.
claims.statement: Coherent officially productizes LPE-grown bismuth-doped rare-earth iron garnet (BIG) thick films — the 'principal Faraday rotator materials' for isolators, circulators and switches — with the FLL series covering 1290-1610 nm, i.e. including the O-band where Google's Apollo program re-engineered circulators for datacenter-scale bidirectional OCS links. This gives the newly added garnet material layer its first named supplier, and together with the 2D collimator array launch makes Coherent a named supplier at two upstream layers of the same OCS optical path. Limits: vendor datasheet (self-report); multi-supplier crystal market (Japanese growers not yet researched); no volume, share or customer data; Google's actual garnet sourcing undisclosed; negligible COHR revenue share.

sources.quote: Bismuth-doped rare-earth iron garnet (BIG) thick films are the principal Faraday rotator materials for non-reciprocal passive optical devices in telecommunications applications.

Faraday rotators can be made into polarization dependent and independent isolators as well as incorporated into a host of other non-reciprocal devices including isolators, circulators and switches. ... BIG Thick Film single crystals are grown by Liquid Phase Epitaxy
